title: ES 5 RXV · Retracement & recovery
summary: Reversal outcomes by preceding leg size, direction, year and all seven session windows. Select a chart, analysis and saved-row filters; exact counts are downloadable.

sections.title: Read the reversal sequence
sections.body: R is the first completed non-doji candle directly after a completed opposite-colour candle. A bullish R follows a bearish leg; a bearish R follows a bullish leg. n counts additional candles after R: preceding bearish,bearish,bearish → bullish R → bullish F1 → bullish F2 is a 3-candle preceding leg and a success at n=2. Known preceding lengths use the whole observed leg; unknown starts have their own group. All preceding legs includes every reversal, including unknown starts. Choose year, session and preceding leg in the tables. All years + All hours gives overall; a year + All hours gives yearly; All years + a named window gives session; a year + a window gives year-by-session. The All preceding legs row overlaps the disjoint size rows; do not sum it with them. F1 is the immediate next completed candle. Retracement is a touch of 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of R's body from its close toward its open; equality counts. A favorable close is strictly beyond R.close in R's direction. 100% reaches R.open, rather than the outer wick. Joint rate = touch AND favorable / known F1; conditional rate = touch AND favorable / touched F1. These answer different questions. OHLC establishes a touch and final close, without resolving the full intrabar path or a tradable fill.

sections.title: Overall sample
sections.patternFocus: This section measures sample and coverage, rather than a pattern's success. Exact, censored or unavailable outcomes retain their saved definitions.

sections.title: Overall F1 retracement and recovery
sections.description: Joint % = touch + favorable / known F1. Conditional % = touch + favorable / touched. Unknown F1 is excluded from both denominators; undefined estimates remain blank.
sections.patternFocus: Measure immediate F1 body touches at each stated depth and its close beyond R.close. Joint rates use known F1; conditional recovery rates use touched F1. R.open is the 100% body level.

sections.title: Bullish reversal · 25% body retracement by preceding leg
sections.description: Joint % = touch + favorable / known F1. Conditional % = touch + favorable / touched. Unknown F1 is excluded from both denominators; undefined estimates remain blank.
sections.patternFocus: Measure only F1 at the 25% level from R.close toward R.open. Touch is inclusive; favorable close is strictly beyond R.close. Touch/known F1, joint/known F1 and favorable/touched F1 use different denominators.

sections.title: Timing, windows and interpretation
sections.body: Event groups use R's completion proxy (when the signal becomes known), rather than its opening or outcome time. Year uses its inferred 18:00-rollover session date. Follow-up continues across named-window endpoints but never across inferred daily sessions or completion barriers. NY wall-time windows: Asia 20:00–02:00; London 02:00–09:00; NY 09:30–16:00; Asia Open 19:30–21:30; NY Open 09:30–10:30; NY AM 10:30–12:30; NY PM 12:30–16:00. Start included, end excluded. Overlapping windows cannot all be summed. 2019 and 2026 have partial coverage. The entire partial final session 2026-09-24 is excluded. Bar coverage is anchored at bar opening, separately from event completion-time groups. Original same-second and identical rows retain source order. OHLC is available; volume, exact completion and contract/roll treatment are unverified. These are descriptive historical frequencies on already-inspected history, without independent forecast validation, iid confidence intervals or trading profitability evidence.

notes: Pooled-direction results and exact unrounded counts/rates for every year, window and preceding-leg cohort are included in CSVs. Displayed rates retain six decimals before formatting.
Continuation uses candle colour; F1 recovery uses its close relative to R.close. A gap can make these outcomes differ.

downloads.label: All F1 retracement and recovery outcomes
downloads.description: Exact saved strings, including all 15 preceding-leg cohorts, all directions, overall, yearly, seven windows and year-by-window. Blank estimates are undefined. All cohort overlaps its size cohorts; do not sum them together.
downloads.population: Observed adjacent completed reversals. Unknown future outcomes are separately retained; prior unknown-start legs have their own cohort.
downloads.units: Probabilities are ratios; counts are reversals or sessions as labeled. n is additional candles after R; depth is percent of R body.

patterns.title: F1 body retracement and recovery
patterns.description: Measure the immediate next candle F1 against R's body, from R.close toward R.open. The 100% level is R.open, not the outer wick. Schematic candles in normalized illustrative units; not actual market bars or RXV geometry.

variants.title: Bullish touch and favorable close
variants.description: One successful example: F1 touches the level and closes strictly above R.close. A touched F1 can instead close at or behind R.close. Equality counts for touch, not favorable close. OHLC does not identify intrabar order.

variants.title: Bearish touch and favorable close
variants.description: One successful example: F1 touches the level and closes strictly below R.close. A touched F1 can instead close at or behind R.close. Equality counts for touch, not favorable close. OHLC does not identify intrabar order.
